new_sources.title: On Hrushovski's proof of the Manin-Mumford conjecture
new_sources.author: Richard Pink and Damian Roessler
new_sources.publication_note: ICM 2002, vol. I, 539-546; stored arXiv:math/0212408v1 dated 1 December 2002, 8 pages. Theorem 2.4 (PDF pp.4-5) is the directly used invariant-subvariety input; no no-algebraic-unit strengthening is used.

new_sources.title: Deformation in the large of some complex manifolds, II
new_sources.author: Fabrizio Catanese and Paola Frediani
new_sources.publication_note: Original author manuscript arXiv:math/0507508v1, margin 25 July 2005; title page body date 18 May 2005, 23 pages. Theorem 3.6 and Proposition 3.7/Lemma 3.9/Corollary 3.10 directly used. Restricted-dimension Theorem 4.11 is not used.

reused_sources.role: Only note73 global affine conjugacy exit; not used for note71 or note72 geometric theorem.

distinctions.original_hypotheses: Albanese dimensions 0,2,4; projective; surjective; no divisorial critical values; W upper bound and actual Anosov leaf annihilation.
distinctions.maximum_branch: W dimension 4 is an explicit unproved interface; note72 fully recovers principal torus bundle.
distinctions.model_exit: Uses old Appell-Humbert and the previously audited 2026 Wehler preprint.
distinctions.missing: No general W lower bound and no exclusion of Albanese dimensions 0 or 2.
